title: The history of the social survey – the social survey in history
source: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
summary: The social survey as we know it today has roots far back in modern history. It dates back to the idea of the Enlightenment that careful description of natural species, formations of clouds, the population etc. could give an insight that was worth getting. The paper will outline the history of the social survey starting from the studies of the poor in the UK carried out by philanthropists up till the social surveys carried out continuously in the modern welfare state. One aspect of this history is the formation of data archives in a wide range of nation states around the world since the 1960s.
